messages:
ops-bot: Incident created: auth-provider-token-verification-errors. Paging oncall: @emma-l. Sev: P1. /incident create #auth-provider-token-verification-errors

emma-l (oncall): got the page, looking now. any customer reports?

maria-gh: support seeing spike in console login errors, multiple customers reporting 401s on API calls that validate tokens. tickets incoming.

raj-patel: seeing errors in token-introspect path: ~40% 502/504 from Auth0/okta endpoints for last 6m. traceback from our auth-proxy: `introspect_remote_error: 502 Bad Gateway`.

emma-l (oncall): nice. can you paste the failing log lines?

raj-patel: ```
2026-03-15T12:02:31Z auth-proxy ERROR remote_introspect: status=502 body="Bad Gateway" url=https://auth.example.com/introspect token_id=abc123
2026-03-15T12:03:05Z auth-proxy WARN jwks_fetch failed: timeout after 5s
```

lina-s: Observability vendor (traces) also shows spike in request latency to auth provider, followed by downstream 401s from our edge.

derek-k: quick customer impact: Login flow fails (console) and API token-verification returns 401 for requests that rely on remote introspect. Embedded clients using local JWT verification unaffected. Impacted: customers on delegated-introspect path and some legacy services.

emma-l (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable cached_jwks fallback 2) switch proxy to offline-verification for tokens with known signing kid 3) add rate-limit and circuit-breaker to remote introspect path to protect downstream. Who can flip the feature flags?

raj-patel: I can flip flags. Preparing patch to use cached JWKS for 1h TTL and fall back to introspect only if kid not found. Will push canary to small percentage first.

maria-gh: I'll post customer-facing status in status.redwood.ai that says: "Investigating login and API verification errors affecting some customers; we have applied temporary mitigations and will update within 30 minutes."

ops-bot: @emma-l acknowledged incident. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.runbooks/auth-introspect-failures

emma-l (oncall): executing mitigation steps now. Raj, coordinate canary. Maria, post status and triage support tickets for VIPs. Derek, collect list of services still failing after fallback. Lina, keep trace evidence.

raj-patel: rolling canary: toggling `use_cached_jwks=true` for 5% of traffic on auth-proxy pool-3. Watch logs: `auth-proxy[canary] INFO jwks cached used for kid=xyz`.

(2m later)

raj-patel: canary shows reduced 401s in that shard, remote introspect calls decreased by ~75% on canary hosts. No errors introduced. Increasing to 30%.

emma-l (oncall): good. ramp to 100% with staged rollout, and enable circuit-breaker (5s backoff) on introspect to prevent flooding vendor.

ops-bot: config-change: circuit_breaker:introspect -> 5s backoff applied by raj-patel.

maria-gh: status page updated: "Mitigation applied: switched to cached signature verification and reduced dependency calls. We continue to monitor; some users may still see errors short-term." :white_check_mark:

derek-k: collecting list: console sessions recovered for 84% of impacted users after rollout. Remaining failing flows are tokens issued in the last 5 minutes that used a rotated key not present in cache.

lina-s: traces show Auth0/Okta returning 502s intermittently; vendor status page shows partial outage in region eu-west-1: https://status.okta.com/incidents/abcd-2026-03-15 (linked).

emma-l (oncall): escalate to vendor SRE: @raj can you open support escalation with Okta and share logs (include upstream 502s and timestamps)? Also attach request id samples.

raj-patel: raised ticket 79234 with Okta, attaching logs and a request for JWKS push propagation info.

(10m)

ops-bot: update: #auth-provider-token-verification-errors severity remains P1.

emma-l (oncall): temporary customer workaround: ask clients to validate JWTs locally where possible or retry token introspect after 10s. For those using delegated introspect, we'll keep fallback until vendor confirms resolution. Maria, include workaround notes in support responses.

maria-gh: done. support template: 
`We are aware of token verification errors due to third-party auth provider failures. We have enabled cached verification on our side; if you continue to see 401s, please restart your session or wait 30s for propagation. Contact support with your request id.`

raj-patel: metrics: auth-introspect calls dropped from 1200/min to 300/min, 401s dropped by 70% overall. Still see intermittent spikes when vendor comes back briefly then fails.

lina-s: added dashboard panel: auth-introspect errors, jwks-fetch latency, and circuit-breaker tripped counts. Sharing link: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/auth-introspect (internal link).

(30m)

okta-support: Thanks for the ticket. We are investigating a partial cache invalidation issue in eu-west-1 that can cause JWKS fetches to return 502 during rotation. We'll update when we have cause and ETA.

emma-l (oncall): thanks. keep monitoring. Raj, keep fallback enabled until Okta confirms stable.

raj-patel: leaving cached_jwks=true and circuit-breaker in prod. Patching auth-proxy to persist last-known good JWKS across restarts (PR ready).

derek-k: customer impact summary so far: ~12% of active sessions affected at peak; major pain for console logins in eu-west-1 for 20m window; no data loss; APIs that perform local JWT verification unaffected.

maria-gh: created incident page on internal tracker with impact and timeline, notifying Sales/CS for affected customers.

(1h)

okta-support: Issue mitigated. Cache propagation fix deployed. We recommend backfilling any missing keys; failing calls should now succeed.

lina-s: I'm seeing decrease to baseline on introspect errors. Circuit-breaker tripped counts falling to zero.

emma-l (oncall): switching off forced cached-only mode. will keep circuit-breaker enabled for 15m to smooth churn.

raj-patel: rolled rollback: `use_cached_jwks` -> auto mode. Monitoring.

maria-gh: status page updated: "Resolved — third-party auth provider reported and mitigated an issue; we applied temporary fallbacks; please report if you still see 401s."

ops-bot: incident status changed to: monitoring.

(20m)

emma-l (oncall): closing incident in 20m if metrics hold. Postmortem owners? I can start draft with timeline, Raj for technical details and Lina for traces/dashboards. Maria to handle customer communication summary. Derek for impact numbers and follow-ups.

derek-k: will collect affected customer list and churn-safe messaging.

raj-patel: PR merged to persist JWKS to disk and improve fetch retries. Planning to backport immediately to all clusters.

lina-s: export of traces and key time windows attached to postmortem doc: https://confluence.internal/incidents/1863004500 (internal).

(Incident closed)

ops-bot: Incident 1863004500 resolved and closed. Duration: 1h 6m.

emma-l (oncall): Thanks team. Follow-up action items: 1) backport JWKS persistence across all clusters (raj) 2) add test for vendor JWKS rotation handling (eng-reliability) 3) incident postmortem in 48h with customer comms (maria/derek).

maria-gh: scheduling postmortem and customer notification batch.

raj-patel: will open PRs and track in the sprint.

lina-s: will keep dashboards and alert thresholds tuned to detect similar patterns earlier.

emma-l (oncall): closing thread — good work. :tada:
